courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 船體焊道無損檢測
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以海試載重工況基準建立起點，接到試前試後通道校正的系統介面，最後用需求證據與未通過項目整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Trial loading-state reference, connect through Pre/post-trial calibration, then integrate evidence using Requirement evidence and failed items. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 商船海上試航驗收
history.text: 本專題以海試載重工況基準建立起點，接到試前試後通道校正的系統介面，最後用需求證據與未通過項目整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Trial loading-state reference, connect through Pre/post-trial calibration, then integrate evidence using Requirement evidence and failed items. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 以假想海試資料建立需求、工況、原始量測、修正和驗證的追溯鏈，不把單次最佳結果當驗收。 在民用海試資料審查室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Build a requirement/condition/raw-data/correction/verification chain using synthetic sea trials rather than one best result. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Civil sea-trial data review laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
